production_contract.play_start: Must be a real owned placed copy at Home Pond; non-egg available actor; condition > 0.2, hunger >= 15, energy >= 10; carnival.blocked false; castle.ready checks motor not off, hose <= 0.15, kink <= 0.6, vent <= 0.2, both ties >= 0.45, latch <= 0.5 and apron <= 0.3. These gates do not yet establish authoritative internal paths or actual pressure sufficient for a given jump.
production_contract.care_start: Same ownership/copy/available/needs gates. Damage blocks any requested program containing motor=on. Blocked weather is allowed when compiled weatherSafe is true. Material thresholds, meaningful initial control state, operator reach, empty occupancy and procedure-level final readiness are not generally request prerequisites.
production_contract.automatic_dispatch: LivingPond.decide may choose an owned placed item at Home Pond according to needs, preferences, learning and cooldown. Only then start(automatic=True) asks castle_work.next_work before choosing surface play. next_work rejects severe-weather words or wind >= 0.8 and prioritizes adverse-weather closure, night closure, stored water, dust, manual hold/damage, ropes, leak/kink, reopening, prints. A listed predicate is a selector witness, not a guarantee the outer utility planner chooses the object.
source_conflicts_to_resolve: Night care closes from hour 20 and before 7; surface selection chooses moon from hour 21 and before 6. Define intentional manual/automatic nighttime play and closing semantics rather than claiming both are always available.
Manual weatherSafe control requests can continue in storm/gale conditions where automatic care refuses and shelter takes precedence. Decide the intended context/support policy.

The play inflate stage drives inflation to 1 after ready checks; ready checks configuration rather than actual powered pressure. Verify the native actuator/pressure prerequisites rather than treating the staging inflation as evidence of functioning airflow.

execution_rules: Reserve each actor, component stance, doorway passage and object copy once. The initial implementation may serialize occupants; it must prevent care while riders occupy the house.

Give two-person play a readiness/role-handoff barrier. Optional solo completion must have a truthful solo interpretation, not an absent partner performance.

Cancellation preserves already-applied effects, withdraws along a valid exit when available, releases reservations and never grants ordinary/shared completion. Save pauses the authoritative local root and event cursors; old helpers do not resurrect.
